trials.description: Current Champion: M60 residual-momentum Long + equal fundamental-deterioration Short
21-observed-day raw turnover arithmetic mean; high turnover Long
DTI daily CS-rank target, no smoothing
T2 score with EWMA alpha=0.25, adjust=False

feature_definitions.turnover: raw Volume_t / last strictly-prior disclosed NumberOfIssuedAndOutstandingSharesAtTheEndOfFiscalYearIncludingTreasuryStock; shares age <=450 calendar days; raw scale, no log transform
feature_definitions.chronological: [TO_t, TO_t-1, ..., TO_t-20] within independent listing segments
feature_definitions.sorted: ascending sort of the same 21 values
feature_definitions.missing_history: nonfinite/zero-volume/insufficient 21 observations score 0.0 neutral; no rows dropped
feature_definitions.timing: t-day Volume is permitted by competition timing

model: StandardScaler + ElasticNet, annual expanding refits; T1 raw target and T2/T3 daily cross-sectional percentile-rank target

selection_rule.preflight_required: PIT denominator coverage, strict disclosure timing, and raw-volume/share corporate-action compatibility
